description: This file defines the main engine configuration data structure and associated functions for a firmware project. It includes macros, structure declarations, function prototypes, and documentation comments related to engine configuration parameters.

methods.name: getRpmMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the RPM multiplier based on the operation mode.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the engine operation mode in the configuration.

methods.name: prepareVoidConfiguration
methods.description: Prepares an engine configuration object with default or empty values.

methods.name: setDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the default values for engine configuration parameters.

methods.name: setTargetRpmCurve
methods.description: Initializes the RPM curve for the engine based on input data.

methods.name: setAfrMap
methods.description: Sets the Air-Fuel Ratio map.

methods.name: setMap
methods.description: Sets a fuel or ignition map with a specified value.

methods.name: setWholeFuelMap
methods.description: Configures the entire fuel map with a single value.

methods.name: setWholeIgnitionIatCorr
methods.description: Sets the entire IAT correction for ignition timing.

methods.name: setFuelTablesLoadBin
methods.description: Configures load bins for fuel tables.

methods.name: setWholeIatCorrTimingTable
methods.description: Sets the entire IAT correction timing table.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable_d
methods.description: Sets the entire timing table.

methods.name: printFloatArray
methods.description: Prints a float array with a given prefix.

methods.name: setDefaultBasePins
methods.description: Sets default base pins for engine hardware.

methods.name: setDefaultSerialParameters
methods.description: Sets default serial communication parameters.

methods.name: setDefaultSdCardParameters
methods.description: Sets default parameters for SD card interface.

methods.name: rememberCurrentConfiguration
methods.description: Remembers or saves the current engine configuration.

methods.name: incrementGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Increments the version number of the global configuration.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of the global configuration.

methods.name: commonFrankensoAnalogInputs
methods.description: Handles analog inputs configuration for the Frankenso board.

methods.name: setFrankenso0_1_joystick
methods.description: Configures joystick settings for Frankenso hardware.

methods.name: copyTargetAfrTable
methods.description: Copies an AFR table from source to destination.

methods.name: copyFuelTable
methods.description: Copies a fuel map table.

methods.name: copyTimingTable
methods.description: Copies an ignition timing table.
